### Improvements
- Added search to the views list and moved Edit, Rename, Duplicate, and Delete into a three-dot menu, while keeping enable toggles and drag-to-reorder controls.
- Added a native rename dialog with name validation and keyboard support.
- Added a deletion confirmation dialog with a destructive primary action. Canceling leaves the view and its templates unchanged.
- Used Bases’ native filter sheet on mobile, including its property pickers, scrolling, and dismissal controls. Desktop filters remain inline.

### Bug Fixes
- Prevented accidental deletion from the views list and its keyboard shortcuts by requiring confirmation.
- Closed native filter sheets and cleaned up their controls when the editor is dismissed.
- Fixed the version-bump script skipping a version entry when its minimum Obsidian version was unchanged.

### Tests
- Added coverage for confirmation and cancellation, view search, keyboard deletion, and mobile filter mounting and cleanup.
- Verified search, action menus, rename dialogs, and the mobile filter sheet in Obsidian.
